verdict.rationale: GitLab documents its own automatic false-positive detection after each security scan, with confidence scores and explanations (Ultimate plus Duo add-on). It also lets users mark a detected secret as a false positive during push protection. Neither item shows that flagged findings are then suppressed so only new issues alert. missing for 10: documented dismiss/ignore workflow for existing findings, baseline mechanism that limits alerts to newly introduced issues, evidence that false-positive verdicts suppress alerts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can baseline or ignore existing and false-positive findings so only new issues alert

citations.quote: false positive detection runs automatically after each security scan and provides confidence scores with explanations for each assessment
